remarks: Set within one of Pasadena's most distinctive residential enclaves, this exceptional Linda Vista residence offers a compelling blend of refined design, resort-style living, and effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. Completely remodeled and meticulously maintained, the four-bedroom, four-bath home is ideally situated near Pasadena's celebrated cultural, dining, and recreational destinations. Elegant double front doors open to a welcoming foyer, where a dramatic curved staircase and custom glass-enclosed elevator create a memorable first impression.
